findings.evidence: `Monoidal.lean:81-83` declares `variable (C : Type v) [AddCommMonoid C] [Module R C] [Coalgebra R C]` and `variable (A : Type u) [Semiring A] [Algebra R A]`; `Finite/ScalarExtension/Basic.lean:39-41` declares the identical variables and its docstring (line 22) states "No finiteness or bialgebra structure is needed for the construction". The body of `autOfComponents` (Monoidal.lean:93-119) cites only `NatIso.ofComponents`, `eqToIso`, `FGComoduleCat.scalarExtensionFunctor_obj`, `FGComoduleCat.scalarExtensionFunctor_map`, `toLinearEquiv.toModuleIsoₛ`, `cancel_epi`/`cancel_mono`, `SemimoduleCat.hom_ext` — all available at `Finite/ScalarExtension/Basic.lean`.
findings.fix: Move `autOfComponents` and `autOfComponents_hom_app` to `TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/Finite/ScalarExtension/Basic.lean` in namespace `TauCeti.FGComoduleCat` (adding `public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.GeneralLinearGroup.Basic` there for `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup`), and reference it as `FGComoduleCat.autOfComponents` from `monoidalAutOfComponents`, which stays here because it consumes the pre-existing `isMonoidal_of_linear_components`.
findings.issue: `autOfComponents` (and `autOfComponents_hom_app`, line 121) is generic API for `FGComoduleCat.scalarExtensionFunctor`: it assumes only `[Coalgebra R C]`, `[Semiring A] [Algebra R A]` (lines 81-83), needs no bialgebra, no Hopf algebra, no point action, and uses nothing declared in this file — only `FGComoduleCat.scalarExtensionFunctor_obj`/`_map`. Living in `AlgebraicGroup/Representation/Tannaka/Monoidal.lean` under namespace `TauCeti.Tannaka` hides the canonical way to build an automorphism of that functor from anyone working with comodule scalar extension.

summary: Imports are clean and the new files join correct directories, but the new coalgebra-level constructor `Tannaka.autOfComponents` has no Tannaka content and belongs with the functor it builds automorphisms of, in `Finite/ScalarExtension/Basic.lean`.
